_comment: USER-MAINTAINED reference data, NOT legal advice. Rates differ by product/service and change over time; verify against official CBIC/GST Council notifications. The optional rate check only warns when the implied overall rate matches none of the listed rates for the invoice date. A mixed-rate invoice can legitimately show a blended rate.

periods.note: Rate slabs commonly used before the 2025 GST rate rationalisation. Verify before relying on it.
Rate slabs commonly used after the 22 Sep 2025 rationalisation. Verify before relying on it; goods and services may have transitional or special rates.
